command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP: backup fstab ==="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "=== STEP: remove any existing /tmp or /dev/shm fstab lines ==="
sudo -n sed -i -E '/^\S+\s+\/tmp\s+/d; /^\S+\s+\/dev\/shm\s+/d' /etc/fstab

echo "=== STEP: append hardened fstab entries ==="
printf 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,seclabel 0 0\n' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
printf 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,seclabel 0 0\n' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "=== STEP: current fstab ==="
cat /etc/fstab

echo "=== STEP: apply live - /dev/shm remount ==="
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm
echo "=== STEP: apply live - /tmp mount (fresh tmpfs mount over /tmp) ==="
if mountpoint -q /tmp; then
  sudo -n mount -o remount /tmp
else
  sudo -n mount /tmp
fi

echo "=== STEP: verify live mount options ==="
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /tmp
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /dev/shm

echo "=== STEP: functional check noexec/nosuid/nodev on /tmp ==="
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho hello\n' > /tmp/exectest.sh
chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh
if /tmp/exectest.sh 2>/tmp/exectest.err; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: script executed on /tmp"
else
  echo "OK: execution blocked on /tmp"
  cat /tmp/exectest.err || true
fi

echo "=== STEP: functional check noexec on /dev/shm ==="
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho hello\n' > /dev/shm/exectest.sh
chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh
if /dev/shm/exectest.sh 2>/dev/shm/exectest.err; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: script executed on /dev/shm"
else
  echo "OK: execution blocked on /dev/shm"
  cat /dev/shm/exectest.err || true
fi

echo "=== DONE ==="
